access_boundary: This record represents the Lyria 3 Clip preview identified by the Gemini API model code lyria-3-clip-preview, launched March 25, 2026 with no shutdown date announced. Its documented output is audio (MP3) with lyrics as text; the record is classed by the audio it exists to produce. Lyria 3 Pro Preview, the generally available Lyria 3.5 of September 3, 2026, Lyria RealTime, and the Vertex-based Lyria products remain separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Google documents a release-specific model page with the model code, inputs, outputs, and a version line marking it as a preview
The changelog and deprecations table name the launch date and state that no shutdown date is announced
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
The deprecations table lists no shutdown date for this preview and the model index now leads with the generally available Lyria 3.5 line, so its continued availability is open
